rule: These directives encode the latest explicit user instruction and supersede older PR descriptions, comments, tests, scheduler summaries and inferred policy whenever they conflict. Autonomous research, remediation, promotion and integration workflows may enforce but may not redefine this file.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, available sleeve cash, executable depth, authoritative fees, slippage, adverse markout, uncertainty/capital-time economics, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one unified V7 PAPER engine on main

model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: leave-targets-out factor basis, null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, phi^h forecast and PnL-unit hedge ratios; evaluate 30m and 60m separately
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons
model_contracts.micro_maker: optimize fill-conditioned net PnL, not fill probability; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity and adverse markout are required; exits/markouts are quantity-specific depth-aware
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; no product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities; explicit partial-state unwind; fixed-horizon executable liquidation for full and partial states; dependence-robust chronological inference
model_contracts.external_intelligence: fail closed; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved probability mapping and evidence

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence

current_priority_order: Keep the unified V7 PAPER runtime single-writer and continuously healthy.
Accumulate prospective execution evidence by exact deployed V7 revision without weakening economics to manufacture trades.
Improve Graph/RV using prospective dual-clock joint-state executable completion and explicit partial-state unwind.
Improve Micro Maker using fill-conditioned PnL, queue/depth, toxicity and bounded-delay markouts.
Improve Micro Taker using complete executable round-trip labels and authoritative fees.
Evaluate PCA, Local Factor and cross-sectional ranking separately by approved horizons with dependence-robust inference.
Keep External Intelligence fail-closed unless probability mapping is validated.
Do not reintroduce retired predecessor runtimes, multi-version adapters, duplicate owners or stale control-plane workflows.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Report any scheduler or PR that conflicts with this directive and flag any reintroduction of retired runtime surfaces.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Treat this file as current operator authorization. Reject retired runtime/adaptor reintroduction, fixed-dollar V7 caps presented as current policy, duplicate owners and authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Prioritize V7 execution evidence and model improvements only; do not dispatch predecessor-runtime restoration work.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Promotion remains evidence-gated by exact source provenance, executable costs, OOS evidence, stability, data health and drawdown controls.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Merge only canonical V7 integrations. Refuse retired runtime surfaces, duplicate runtime owners and stale control-plane compatibility.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Dispatch only the existing Promotion Controller after successful validator completion and the Integration Merge after a successful controller completion. Never merge, deploy, mutate paper-validated, reinterpret policy or execute orders directly.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Bind CI, monitoring and V7 live-paper validation to the exact merged V7 SHA.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Enforce V7-only runtime, monitoring and deployment contracts in deterministic tests.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate V7 per-strategy/frequency PnL, fills, markouts, queue/depth, process ownership and exact deployed revision.
scheduler_assignments.live-paper-validation: Validate the unified V7 PAPER engine using public data; do not require arbitrary trade count by weakening economics; advance paper-validated only on exact-SHA success.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-deploy: Deploy only the exact paper-validated V7 revision and preserve PAPER-only/authenticated-disabled separation.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-health: Verify V7 single writer/process ownership, recorder, broker, proxy, Grafana/metrics and deployed SHA; report rather than rewriting policy.
scheduler_assignments.forward-maker-research: Continue prospective maker evidence across HF cadences with fill-conditioned PnL and bounded-delay depth-aware markouts; do not optimize fill count alone.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Rank V7 challengers by executable OOS economics and incremental utility under the current contracts.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Coordinate the current V7 priority order in this file. Dispatch remediation/research only; never reinterpret stale PR text as current authorization.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Test multiple HF cadences with strict receive/exchange freshness, depth, fee, legging and unwind accounting.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive structural/Graph opportunities under the current joint-state/fixed-horizon execution contract, not marginal-fill products or assumed terminal payout floors.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect, store and chronologically validate public information; publish research evidence only and keep probability mapping fail-closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only connectivity only; no policy mutation.
scheduler_assignments.v7-point-in-time-universe-archive: Every 30 minutes archive the exact paper-validated V7 public universe into immutable point-in-time snapshots for causal PCA, Local Factor and ranking research. Remain read-only with respect to champion, orders, PnL and risk state.
scheduler_assignments.v7-cross-sectional-ranking-research: Collect read-only frozen 2h/6h relative cross-sectional ranking evidence with relative-pair-only semantics and chronological holdout; never submit live intents, mutate champion or paper-validated, deploy, reallocate capital or perform authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.v7-market-cache-relay: Keep the V7 public market cache fresh and atomically update only the V7 PAPER execution cache; do not mutate model policy, champion selection or execution state.

forbidden_regressions: Do not reintroduce retired predecessor runtime entrypoints, version adapters, stale workflows or obsolete configs/tests.
Do not reopen a policy whose purpose is to restore a binding fixed-dollar V7 trade cap or lower hard percentage ceilings as alleged current operator authorization.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner or execution ledger.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside this repository except the existing private PAPER runtime/deployment/telemetry channels explicitly registered by the control plane.
